","type":"text/x-markdown","caption":"ports"},"/home/runner/work/tw-plugin-library/tw-plugin-library/wiki/plugins/rimir/ports/README.md":{"title":"/home/runner/work/tw-plugin-library/tw-plugin-library/wiki/plugins/rimir/ports/README.md","text":"# Ports Link TiddlyWiki tiddlers the way node editors connect blocks: every `ref` field of a [kind](https://github.com/rimir-cc/tw-kind) instance becomes a *port*. Drag a wire from a port onto another tiddler, and the link is written into the field. The story river stays your workspace — no extra view. ## Features - **One quiet handle per tiddler** — a dot on the tiddler's right border, visible only while you hover the tiddler. Filled when the tiddler has links, with the number of links next to it. - **Port flyout** — hovering the handle slides out the ports as labelled rows (icon, caption, linked target or count). Filled ports come first; with more than four ports, the empty ones wait behind *+ N empty ports* and show which kinds they accept. - **Drag to connect** — press a port and drag: a wire follows the pointer, tiddlers that fit the port are outlined, and the wire snaps onto the one under the pointer. Release to link. Single-value fields are replaced, multi-value fields get the target added. - **Context dock** — a slim strip on the right screen edge. While you drag, it opens by itself and lists what fits the port: recent targets first, then all candidates. Keep holding and type to filter; Esc cancels. It closes again on release. Click the strip to open it by hand. - **Option sources** — config tiddlers that narrow the dock per port, kind or accepted type. Ships with one that hides archived instances. - **Targets at a glance** — hovering a filled port draws wires to its targets on screen; clicking it lists them, each with × to unlink. - **Both ends** — set `inverse` on the kind field and kind mirrors the link onto the target. ## Prerequisites - [rimir/kind](https://github.com/rimir-cc/tw-kind) — schema (which fields are ports and what they accept) and `inverse` sync - [rimir/theme](https://github.com/rimir-cc/tw-theme) - Optional: [rimir/streams-ports](https://github.com/rimir-cc/tw-streams-ports) for ports on sq/streams rows ## Quick Start 1. Open a tiddler that has a `kind.type` whose kind defines `ref` fields. 2. Hover the tiddler, then the dot on its right border. 3. Drag a port onto another tiddler in the story, or into the dock that opens on the right. 4. Hover the port again to see the new wire; click it to list or unlink targets. ## License MIT — see [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md). Pieces |!Tiddler |!Role | |`viewtemplate` |ViewTemplate segment: transcludes `handle` for every story tiddler with a `kind.type` | |`handle` |The handle of one instance. Reads `ports-tid`, `ports-exclude`, `ports-variant` from scope; renders nothing without ports. Bridges (streams-ports) reuse it | |`layer` |PageTemplate segment: the `<$ports-layer>` widget wrapping `flyout` and `dock` | |`ports-layer.js` |The only JS module: hover timing, drag, wires, typing while dragging, the field write | |`flyout`, `port-row` |Port list of the hovered handle, from `$:/temp/rimir/ports/flyout` | |`dock`, `dock-drag`, `dock-browse`, `dock-tile` |The dock; drag mode reads `$:/temp/rimir/ports/drag` | |`targets/*` |Drop target specs (dock tile, story tiddler) | |`engine` |Functions (`ports.fields`, `ports.values`, `ports.candidates`, option-source matching) on top of kind's engine | !! Flow of a drag ``` hover .ports-handle ──► $:/temp/rimir/ports/flyout {src, exclude} ──► flyout renders press + move a row ──► $:/temp/rimir/ports/drag {src, field, search} ──► dock opens, lists candidates typing ──► drag!!search ──► dock filters release on target ──► src. written (plain addTiddler) ──► kind inverse sync mirrors it ``` The widget hit-tests with `elementFromPoint` and takes the innermost element matching a //target spec//: tiddlers tagged `$:/tags/rimir/ports/target` with a CSS `selector` and the `title-attribute` holding the tiddler title. Ports ships specs for dock tiles and story tiddlers; bridges add their own (streams-ports adds stream rows). During a drag, valid targets get the class `ports-valid`, the one under the pointer `ports-hover`; while a port is hovered, its visible targets get `ports-peek`. A target is valid when it is a kind instance whose type is in the field's `ref-types` (any instance when empty) and is not the source. !! Placement The handle is absolutely positioned against `.tc-tiddler-frame` (which Vanilla gives `position: relative`) at `right: -8px`, so it sits on the border and takes no layout space. A bridge that leaves `top` unset gets the handle at its own vertical position inside the frame — that is how stream rows line up on the same border. !! State tiddlers All transient state lives under `$:/temp/` (not synced, not saved). Only the recent targets per field persist, in `$:/state/rimir/ports/recent/`. Q: Why don't I see a handle? The tiddler needs a `kind.type`, and its kind needs at least one `ref` field. Untyped tiddlers have no schema and therefore no ports. Also check that ports is enabled in the settings. !! Q: How do I link both ends? Add `"inverse": ""` to the ref field in the kind schema. Kind then keeps the target's field in sync, also for links made in kind's own editors or the palette. !! Q: Why do the target lists open on click, not on hover? A list that opens on hover pushes the ports below it down, so they move away under the pointer. Hover draws wires to the targets instead, and the row already shows the first target and the count. !! Q: The dock covers my sidebar. The collapsed strip is 22px wide; the open dock covers the sidebar only while you drag (it closes on release) or while you opened it by hand. !! Q: Can I drop on a tiddler that is not in the story? Yes — on its tile in the dock, which opens while you drag. Type part of its caption to find it. "},"$:/plugins/rimir/ports/doc/overview":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/ports/doc/overview","created":"20261029120000000","modified":"20261029120000000","rdt.hub-category":"ui-framework","rdt.hub-category-name":"UI Framework & Domain Model","rdt.hub-order":"20","rdt.order":"1","rdt.plugin-key":"ports","rdt.plugin-name":"ports","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Drag-to-connect ports on kind instances","rdt.section":"Overview","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page"> <$fill $name="body"> !! What it does Ports turns the `ref` fields of [[kind|$:/plugins/rimir/kind]] instances into connectors you can drag, like the ports of blocks in a graphical editor. You keep working in the normal story river: each instance gets one small handle on its right border, and links are drawn as wires from a port to the target tiddler. !! How you use it # ''Hover'' a tiddler — its handle appears on the right border (filled = it has links, the number = how many). # ''Hover the handle'' — the port flyout slides out: one row per ref field with its icon, caption and current target (or count). # ''Drag'' a port — a wire follows the pointer; tiddlers that fit the port are outlined; the dock on the right opens with the candidates. Type to filter, Esc cancels. # ''Release'' on a tiddler or a dock tile — the link is written. Single fields are replaced, multi fields get the target added. # ''Hover'' a filled port to see wires to its visible targets; ''click'' it to list the targets, each with × to unlink. !! What it builds on * Which fields are ports, their captions and icons, what they accept (`ref-types`) and whether they hold one or many targets (`cardinality`) all come from the kind schema. * Writing both ends of a relation is kind's job: give the field an `inverse` and kind mirrors the link onto the target, whatever wrote it. * Ports for sq/streams rows come from the separate `rimir/streams-ports` bridge, so ports itself knows nothing about streams. Config |!Tiddler |!Default |!Meaning | |`$:/config/rimir/ports/enable` |`yes` |`no` removes handles, flyout and dock | |`$:/config/rimir/ports/options/hide-archived` |shipped |Option source with filter `[!status[archived]]` for all ports | |`$:/plugins/rimir/ports/default-option-filter` |`[!is[blank]]` |Filter used when no option source applies | !! Option source tiddlers Tagged `$:/tags/rimir/ports/option-source`. |!Field |!Required |!Meaning | |`filter` |yes |Runs on the port's candidates (`subfilter`), e.g. `[!status[archived]]` or `[tag[team]]` | |`kind` |no |Only for ports of instances of this kind | |`field` |no |Only for this field key | |`ref-type` |no |Only for fields that accept this kind | |`caption` |no |Shown in the dock footer and the settings | The most specific matching source wins (score: `kind` 4, `field` 2, `ref-type` 1). One source per drag. !! Drop target specs Tagged `$:/tags/rimir/ports/target`. Shipped: `$:/plugins/rimir/ports/targets/dock-tile`, `$:/plugins/rimir/ports/targets/story-tiddler`. |!Field |!Meaning | |`selector` |CSS selector of elements that stand for a tiddler, e.g. `.tc-tiddler-frame[data-tiddler-title]` | |`title-attribute` |Attribute of that element holding the tiddler title | The innermost matching element under the pointer is the target. Classes set on targets: `ports-valid` (fits the dragged port), `ports-hover` (under the pointer), `ports-peek` (target of the hovered port). !! Handle template variables For bridges that put handles elsewhere (`$:/plugins/rimir/ports/handle`): |!Variable |!Meaning | |`ports-tid` |The instance | |`ports-exclude` |Title list of ref fields to leave out | |`ports-variant` |Adds class `ports-handle--`; `tiddler` is used in the story | !! State |!Tiddler |!Fields | |`$:/temp/rimir/ports/flyout` |`src`, `exclude`, `expanded` (fields listing their targets), `show-empty` | |`$:/temp/rimir/ports/drag` |`src`, `field`, `search` | |`$:/temp/rimir/ports/dock-search` |Search text when the dock is open by hand | |`$:/state/rimir/ports/dock` |`open` while opened by hand | |`$:/state/rimir/ports/recent/` |`list` of the last 5 targets | !! Engine functions |!Function |!Returns | |`ports.fields(type-tid, exclude)` |Ref field keys of the kind, in schema order | |`ports.filled(type-tid, tid, exclude)` / `ports.empty(…)` |Ports with / without a value | |`ports.values(type-tid, tid, field-key)` |Linked titles of one port | |`ports.count(type-tid, tid, exclude)` |Number of links | |`ports.option-source(type-tid, field-key, src-kind)` |Title of the option source that applies | |`ports.candidates(type-tid, field-key, src, opt, q)` |Dock candidates | !! Restart `ports-layer.js` is a widget module: reload the browser page after changing it. Everything else refreshes live. Ports Link tiddlers the way node editors connect blocks: every `ref` field of a [[kind|$:/plugins/rimir/kind]] instance becomes a //port//. Drag a wire from a port onto another tiddler, and the link is written into the field. The story river stays your workspace — no extra view. !! Features * ''One quiet handle per tiddler'' — a dot on the tiddler's right border, visible only while you hover the tiddler. Filled when the tiddler has links, with the number of links next to it. * ''Port flyout'' — hovering the handle slides out the ports as labelled rows (icon, caption, linked target or count). Filled ports come first; with more than four ports, the empty ones wait behind //+ N empty ports// and show which kinds they accept. * ''Drag to connect'' — press a port and drag: a wire follows the pointer, tiddlers that fit the port are outlined, and the wire snaps onto the one under the pointer. Release to link. Single-value fields are replaced, multi-value fields get the target added. * ''Context dock'' — a slim strip on the right screen edge. While you drag, it opens by itself and lists what fits the port: recent targets first, then all candidates. Keep holding and type to filter; Esc cancels. It closes again on release. Click the strip to open it by hand. * ''Option sources'' — config tiddlers that narrow the dock per port, kind or accepted type. Ships with one that hides archived instances. * ''Targets at a glance'' — hovering a filled port draws wires to its targets on screen; clicking it lists them, each with × to unlink. * ''Both ends'' — set `inverse` on the kind field and kind mirrors the link onto the target. !! Prerequisites * [[rimir/kind|$:/plugins/rimir/kind]] (schema: which fields are ports and what they accept; `inverse` sync) * [[rimir/theme|$:/plugins/rimir/theme]] * Optional: `rimir/streams-ports` for ports on sq/streams rows !! Quick Start # Open a tiddler that has a `kind.type` whose kind defines `ref` fields. # Hover the tiddler, then the dot on its right border. # Drag a port onto another tiddler in the story, or into the dock that opens on the right. # Hover the port again to see the new wire; click it to list or unlink targets. "},"$:/plugins/rimir/ports/settings":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/ports/settings","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"\whitespace trim !! Ports
<$checkbox tiddler="$:/config/rimir/ports/enable" field="text" checked="yes" unchecked="no" default="yes"> Show port handles and the connect dock
The handle, flyout and dock are added by `$:/plugins/rimir/ports/viewtemplate` and `$:/plugins/rimir/ports/layer`. Switching off takes effect immediately. !! Option sources Tiddlers tagged <> narrow what the dock offers while a port is dragged. Each has a `filter` that runs on the port's candidates (for example `[!status[archived]]`), and optional selectors that say where it applies: |!Field |!Applies when | |`kind` |the dragged port belongs to an instance of this kind | |`field` |the dragged port is this field | |`ref-type` |the field accepts this kind | The source with the most specific match wins (`kind` counts most, then `field`, then `ref-type`); without any match, all candidates are offered. Only one source applies to a drag. <$list filter="[all[shadows+tiddlers]tag[$:/tags/rimir/ports/option-source]!is[draft]sort[title]]" emptyMessage="">
Option sourceSelectorsFilter
None.
